sec.title: Case report
sec.p: Our patient, a 7-year-old boy, had ataxia and cataract.

sec.title: Discussion
sec.p: In the original report, Gamma et al. (2001) found that 5 of 5 affected sibs were homozygous for the variant, whereas their parents were heterozygous carriers. Our patient differs in having cataract.
Other causes of ataxia were excluded (Zeta, 2015).

ref.mixed-citation: Gamma A, Other B. A new recessive ataxia caused by GENEX mutation in two families. Fict J Genet. 2001;12:1-9.
Zeta C. Ataxia work-up in children. 2015.
